description: This file defines the 'OAuthKey' class, which manages OAuth consumer keys, including retrieval, caching, and deletion operations related to OAuth keys within the SuiteCRM project.

classes.name: OAuthKey
classes.description: A class representing OAuth consumer keys, providing methods for retrieving keys by their consumer key, caching, and deletion.

methods.name: getByKey
methods.description: Retrieves an OAuthKey record matching the given consumer key.

methods.name: fetchKey
methods.description: Fetches an OAuthKey object by its key, utilizing cache and database retrieval.

methods.name: mark_deleted
methods.description: Deletes the OAuth key and associated tokens from the database.
